description: One entry inside a ContextUsageSection — a single tool definition, an attached file, one tool result — so a reader can see what the tokens of a section actually are and (when the host allows it) drop one entry without dropping the whole section. The item is the host's data: Label is rendered as text and never localised, and Tokens is counted as reported (a negative value counts as nothing). An item is a BREAKDOWN of its section: when the section reports its own total the items are the detail of that total, never a second measurement.
